title: New GTA 6 Gameplay, Screenshots, Details Revealed as PS5 Launch Nears

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA New GTA 6 Gameplay, Screenshots, Details Revealed as PS5 Launch Nears GTA 6 briefly appears in South Park by Liam Croft 1 hour ago Share: In exactly three weeks' time, GTA 6 will be out on PS5. You have probably already seen enough to know whether you are playing it or not (and we have got details on the GTA 6 release times and preload date ), but for anyone still on the fence, Rockstar has even more gameplay, screenshots, and gameplay details to entice. First of all, the game appeared in South Park (yes, really). As seen in the video below, a TV presenter shows off the game and how you can throw dog poo at people you walk past. It's actual GTA 6 gameplay inside the animated TV show: New gameplay from GTA 6 was shown in the latest ‘SOUTH PARK’ episode. pic.twitter.com/gL2kRKUv2I - DiscussingFilm (@DiscussingFilm) October 29, 2026 Fans have also picked up on the fact that the voice attached to the TV presenter in the clip is that of Tish Hicks, who also voiced the gameplay trailer for GTA 5 . Next up is a bunch of new screenshots, which you can view in the gallery below: Via Edge and GamesRadar , there are also lots of new little details concerning GTA 6 floating around. I've listed some of them below: The overall map is roughly the same size as GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined Red Dead Redemption 2 has heavily impacted the narrative There are fully functioning train and bus systems in the game There's a smell mechanic and characters can react to foul ones NPCs act differently depending on the region of the map you're in You can switch between playing as Jason and Lucia at any time The relationship between Jason and Lucia is measured on a four-point scale You increase it by spending time together You can call a car to your location through the Scooter Bros app on your phone The entire arsenal of weapons you have access to is stored in the boot / trunk of your car Every car has a fuel gauge and engine health, and refilling the tank is easy K9 dog units are part of the police system GTA 6 releases for PS5 on 19th November 2026. What do you make of this latest drop of footage, screenshots, and so much more information? Post your thoughts in the comments below.
